Name: Sam Edit - 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits
Author: comfemshep
Description:
I made this edit so Sam's portrait would match my sprite ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9016]Original here[/url])

The second main file is my sprite in its seasonal variants (Sprite outfit credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]) The seasonal variants can also be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17406?tab=description]here[/url].

Installation:

1. Download this mod.
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxones and talkohlooeys' seasonal portraits[/url] and its requirements.
3. Drop the assets folder from my mod into that mod and allow the files to be overwritten.
Done! :)

Same procedure for the Sprite but with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Poltergeister's mod[/url] instead :)
